title: GemNFT Metadata
description: Standard metadata for Gemstone NFTs tracking provenance from mine to market.

name.description: Identifying name of the gemstone NFT (e.g. 'Certified Blue Sapphire GEM-001')

description.description: Detailed description of the gemstone, heritage, and traceability.

image.description: IPFS URI (ipfs://...) of the primary gemstone visual (360-degree render or microscopic scan).

external_url.description: Link to the system's public verification portal for this GemID.

animation_url.description: IPFS URI for a video or 3D model (GLB/GLTF) of the gemstone.
